body:
What you're trying to achieve seems to be a "disjunctive hierarchical menu". This feature is not supported in our [JavaScript Helper](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js) (the underlying library that manages the state) because it would trigger too many requests to the Algolia API.

If despite this technical constraint you'd still like to implement this feature, the only solution as of now would be to see how the Helper manages hierarchical facets and to support multiple selections in a custom hierarchical menu widget.

Closing because duplicate of #1658. You can subscribe to this issue to be notified when we plan to support this feature.
